Category C+E · Example Town

Category C+E training

Trailer training for articulated lorries and drawbar combinations. This page explains the licence and the practical work involved.

Enquire about Category C+ECall 01632 960960

What C+E allows you to drive

Category C+E adds a trailer to the rigid lorry licence. It covers articulated lorries and drawbar combinations.

  • Articulated lorries
  • Rigid lorries towing a drawbar trailer

You train in our own articulated unit and trailer.

Who it is for

Drivers who already hold Category C and want to add a trailer. It isn't the first step up from a car licence.

If you're still moving up from a car licence, start withCategory C training.

Eligibility guidance

General guidance only. We check the licence you hold when you enquire.

  • Category C is the usual licence held before C+E training
  • We check the licence you hold before training is arranged
  • We explain any medical or theory steps that still apply
  • This page is general guidance and can't confirm eligibility for an individual

Training programme

The practical work a C+E course is built around.

  • Coupling and uncoupling
  • Reversing and manoeuvres with a trailer
  • On-road driving with the combination
  • Guidance on what the practical test involves

Vehicle and training environment

Training is yard work and road driving from our base. Coupling, uncoupling and trailer manoeuvres are the practical core of a C+E course.

You practise coupling and reversing in the yard before moving on to the road with the combination.

How long it takes

How long training takes depends on the licence you already hold, your driving experience and how the sessions are arranged. We agree a plan with you when you enquire, rather than quoting a standard length.

Price and quotes

We don't publish a fixed price list, because the right training depends on the licence you hold and how much practice you need. Ask for a quote for the course you want. Medical, theory test and practical test fees are separate costs, and we explain them when we quote.

Ask for a Category C+E quote

Common questions

Do I need Category C before C+E?

Category C is the usual licence held before trailer training. If you don't hold it yet, start with Category C training.

What will I be driving?

An articulated lorry or a drawbar combination, depending on the entitlement you need.

How long does Category C+E take?

It depends on your experience with a trailer. We agree a plan with you when you enquire.

How do I get a quote?

Use the enquiry form or call us and say you're asking about Category C+E.
